expectations.because: a listing recipe answers one page, never every row (findings after 0.19.1)
the page fits the host's answer before it spills to a file
the page states the count the recipe's first request answered
the precondition: more than one page follows the first, so a replay that answered every remaining row would fail its row bound
the page carries the after that asks for the rest
every component declares its level and no requirement carries one, so the effective count is the declared one, read off the model's files; it is part of the layer, not all of it
replaying the first page's after (which that page must state as truncated) answers rows the first page does not list
a continued page is a page too: replaying the cursor answers at most the next page, never every row after it
the continued page fits the host's answer too
